atom.linePrev: So I've heard, but what's that gotta do
atom.line: With this atom bomb in me?
stanza: Oh, and no one ever knows the real you
So I've heard, but what's that gotta do
With this atom bomb in me?

atom.linePrev: And I saw that my blood had no bounds
atom.line: Spreading in a circle like an atom bomb
atom.lineNext: Soaking and felling everything in its path
stanza: I had a dream you came to me
Said, "You shall not do me harm anymore"
And with your knife, you evicted my life
From its little lighthouse on the seashore
And I saw that my blood had no bounds
Spreading in a circle like an atom bomb
Soaking and felling everything in its path
And welling in my heart like a birdbath
